grading_note: UK 30-year gilt yield closed at 5.82% on August 18, 2026 per Trading Economics; this exceeds the 5.65% threshold, falsifying the falsifier and proving the claim.

claim: US headline CPI (due Aug 13) prints at or above July's annual pace, keeping a September Fed cut priced as a toss-up rather than a lock.
falsification_criteria: Headline CPI y/y comes in below the prior month's reading, i.e., inflation decelerates on the print.

claim: Bitcoin closes August above its Aug 1 opening price, delivering a positive monthly candle consistent with the flagged 15-year bottom signal confirming rather than failing.
falsification_criteria: Bitcoin closes August 31 below its August 1 opening price.
grading_note: Technical bottom signals draw attention because they've historically been reliable; absent a macro shock, the path of least resistance into month-end skews higher.

claim: Brent crude closes Aug 13 up less than 2% from today, failing to spike despite the disabled tanker.
falsification_criteria: Brent settlement price on Aug 13 is up 2% or more versus the Aug 12 close.
grading_note: Brent crude settled at $87.92/Bbl on Aug 13, 2026, down 1.19% from Aug 12 close per Investing.com; falsifier requires ≥+2% move — not met. Claim proven.

claim: AstraZeneca shares close Aug 13 up at least 3% from today, recovering over half of this week's merger-rumor selloff.
falsification_criteria: AZN closes Aug 13 flat or down versus the Aug 12 close.
grading_note: AstraZeneca closed at 11,702.00 GBp on August 13, 2026, down 2.40% from the prior day's close (approximately 11,994 GBp per JournalArta); the prediction required an up move of at least 3%, but the falsification criteria (flat or down close) was clearly met.

claim: US spot Bitcoin ETFs post net inflows below $400m for the week ending Aug 19, roughly half this week's $854m pace.
falsification_criteria: Weekly net inflow data (Farside Investors/SoSoValue) shows $400m or more for the week ending Aug 19.

claim: CME FedWatch-implied probability of a September Fed cut rises above 90% by Aug 19.

falsification_criteria: USD/JPY trades below 155 at any point before Sept 11 close.
grading_note: Joint intervention moves front-load currency moves and fade; BofA's full-year 6% call implies a gradual grind, not a break below 155 within a month.

claim: UK 30-year gilt yield breaches 5.85% before Sept 11, extending this week's climb toward 5.7%.
falsification_criteria: The 30-year gilt yield stays below 5.85% at every close through Sept 11.
grading_note: This is a global long-bond selloff, not just a UK story, and it's compounding with pre-budget fiscal scrutiny of Reeves' headroom — both pressures build into September rather than resolve.

claim: CME FedWatch-implied odds of a September Fed rate cut rise above 90% by Thursday's close, up from today's split sentiment.
falsification_criteria: CME FedWatch September-cut probability closes Aug 14 at or below 90%, or has fallen versus today.

Market was pricing in a hike or hold due to Iran energy shocks keeping inflation elevated, per CME FedWatch Tool and CNBC/Motley Fool reporting.

claim: USD/JPY closes higher on Aug 14 than today's close, as the AI-earnings risk-on move (Nebius, CoreWeave, Nikkei highs) keeps yen-funded carry trades attractive.
falsification_criteria: USD/JPY closes Aug 14 at or below today's (Aug 13) closing level.

claim: Applied Materials falls more than 5% in the session immediately after its earnings release this week, as the 105% YTD rally invites profit-taking on any in-line print.
falsification_criteria: AMAT's post-earnings session close is down less than 5% from its pre-earnings close, or the stock rises.

claim: GBP/USD falls at least 1% from today's close by Aug 20, as gilt yields near 1998 highs and pre-budget fiscal anxiety outweigh Labour's improved poll standing.
falsification_criteria: GBP/USD is flat or higher, or down less than 1%, versus today's close on Aug 20.

claim: S&P 500 closes on Sept 12 no more than 3% above today's (Aug 13) level, lagging the pace implied by Wall Street's newly lifted 8,400 year-end targets.

claim: The PHLX Semiconductor Index (SOX) sets at least one new 52-week closing high before Aug 21, extending today's AI-capex rally.

claim: Bitcoin does not set a new all-time-high close by Aug 21, despite this week's White House crypto-industry summit.

claim: FTSE 100 sets at least one further record closing high between Aug 15 and Sep 14, extending Friday's fresh record.
falsification_criteria: Falsified if the FTSE 100 fails to close above Friday Aug 14's record high at any point through Sep 14.

claim: Nvidia shares close up at least 5% within three trading days of its Aug 26 earnings report.

claim: The Paramount Skydance–Warner Bros Discovery deal has not formally closed by Sept 15, despite clearing US and UK antitrust review.

claim: Nikkei 225 sets a fresh record closing high at some point before Sept 16, extending the weak-yen export rally.

grading_note: A softer retail print sharpens the case for a cut even with hawkish dissenters still on the committee, and the market has room to price a September move more fully by mid-September.

claim: US 30-year Treasury yield falls at least 15bps from today's close by September 17, as the multi-decade-high selloff partially mean-reverts.

claim: US high-yield-over-investment-grade credit spread widens by at least 20bps from today's level by September 17, as the sovereign bond rout spreads into corporate credit.

grading_note: A global long-end yield surge alongside oil-driven inflation risk and a slowing China backdrop typically pressures risk premia before it shows up in equity indices.

claim: GBP/USD falls at least 0.5% from today's close by Friday Aug 21 as gilt-market fiscal stress outweighs the hawkish-BoE reading of the inflation surprise.
falsification_criteria: GBP/USD closes Friday flat or higher versus its 2026-08-19 close.

claim: Meta shares recover from this week's 'wobble', closing Friday Aug 21 no more than 1% below Monday's (Aug 17) close.
falsification_criteria: Meta closes Friday down more than 2% versus its 2026-08-17 close.
grading_note: A trial seeking $1.4tn in damages generates headline risk but resolves over years, not days; single-day 'wobbles' on opening statements typically fade within the week.

claim: VIX closes below 20 every session through Friday Aug 21, despite the bond selloff and Eigen's 2008-style AI-bubble warning.
falsification_criteria: VIX closes above 20 on any trading day between 2026-08-19 and 2026-08-21.
